goal: A small, honest, easy-to-inspect professional reference for coordinating evidence-based AI and organizational work, without disclosing private platform IP.
profile_context: The owner seeks cross-corporate project/program and transformation assignments including AI. These repositories can demonstrate concrete technical judgment and evidence discipline, not establish unverified CV achievements.

actions.action: Explain the existing healthy/degraded/baseline synthetic ticket classifier with saved reports, explicit constructed-label provenance and fictional time/cohort, confusion counts and different business consequences of false routing; show allocation of costs and missing workflow scope.
actions.acceptance: Never call authored labels independently adjudicated. Distinguish point accuracy, Wilson-bound rule, incomplete labels, confidence heuristic, subgroup size and non-causal baseline. Hand-calculated expectations are regression tested.

actions.action: Stress all duplicate-ID occurrences, pending labels, partial costs/latency, tiny subgroup, threshold basis, HTML escaping, malformed input and output/input path collisions; fix demonstrated defects.
actions.acceptance: No missing outcomes/costs disappear from relevant denominators; negative checks remain visible alongside insufficient evidence; no input overwrite.

actions.action: Put one safe offline command and a concise expected result near the top; link a readable saved report and a reproducible case study.
actions.acceptance: A reader can understand purpose, run command, expected verdict and limits in the first screen.

actions.action: Add a runnable standard-library JSON report consumer with fail-closed structural checks, distinct error/negative/unknown/sample-met outcomes, tests and an explicit no-action-authority output.
actions.acceptance: Exit 0 only for structurally consistent declared sample eligibility, exit 1 for negative/unknown, exit 2 for invalid/error reports. No exit status grants action authority; no source authenticity or underlying-data recomputation is performed.

actions.action: Use Markdown links in llms.txt, consistent references to the owner-selected license and a prominent modest cross-reference to all three independent showcases; maintain AGENTS.md and project-local showcase.json.
actions.acceptance: No invented interoperability standard, purchase permission, software integration or production claim.

actions.action: Add offline CI for Python 3.11 and 3.13, tests for core/CLI/consumer and deterministic example reproduction. Keep optional MCP tests separate and visible.
actions.acceptance: No model or credentials required in default CI; read-only token permissions; local test counts and skipped tests reported honestly.

actions.action: Describe the demonstrated work: requirements, explicit decision rules, evidence boundaries, implementation and responsible next steps. Add short support/contribution/security guidance and maintenance scope.
actions.acceptance: No unverified CV achievements, customer outcomes, enterprise readiness or commercial demand claims.

actions.action: Include the owner-selected Noncommercial Local Use License 1.1.0 with the explicitly approved noncommercial completed report exception; align current human/agent metadata and packaging. Do not add business-evaluation or public-code-contribution exceptions.
actions.acceptance: No implicit free-use or redistribution grant and no claim that source availability is open source.

action: Protect input/config/baseline files from output collisions, including symbolic and hard links.
Describe confusion counts as external case analysis; core measures exact categorical label agreement, not asymmetric financial loss.
Provide defensive consumer, authored-label provenance, cost scope and reproducible case.
actions.acceptance: Regression tests reproduce the original defects and exercise the repaired behavior; all input files remain byte-identical after refused collisions.

actions.action: Repair the Python 3.11/3.12 floating-point aggregate discrepancy exposed by the first GitHub example replay; use explicit stable accumulation.
actions.acceptance: A focused regression fails before the repair. Stored examples reproduce under both locally available versions; original responses, frozen policy and sample verdicts remain unchanged.

actions.action: Resolve verified AGY/Claude findings in the adjudication table, add focused regressions, regenerate affected synthetic reports and verify core, optional MCP and packaging.
actions.acceptance: No missing-cost-as-zero evidence, no extra human-output rounding, bounded decoder input errors, accurate fictional chronology and recorded rejected suggestions. Keep all rights unchanged.

pre_edit_gate: Record baseline tests and one independent Gemini 3.8 Flash review of this plan and supplied source before repository edits. Revise actions against concrete findings.
publication_gate: Separate evidence for any real customer, commercial or production claim
reference_interpretation: Adopt visible examples, short reproducible entry points, tests and explicit agent guidance. These sources do not prove why users award stars or validate this owner's competence.

adjudication.finding: Low: tiny costs lose precision in text/HTML.
adjudication.reason: Reproduced 0.021053 displayed as 0.02, and 0.0504 above a 0.05 maximum displayed as 0.05. Preserve the serialized value; keep unrounded comparisons.

adjudication.finding: Low / medium: missing cost observations reported as known zero.
adjudication.reason: Reproduced absent column, missing cell and empty cohort. Emit null when no valid cost exists; retain measured zero. No observations yields missing evidence; partial totals remain partial.

adjudication.finding: Low: deeply nested config may raise an unhandled RecursionError.
adjudication.reason: 100,000 nested levels reproduced before edits; rethrow decoder RecursionError as ValueError so CLI returns structured exit 2.

adjudication.finding: Low: review findings lack individual adjudication.
adjudication.reason: Append individual decisions for this round; keep prior record intact rather than rewriting historical decisions.

adjudication.finding: Info / low: constant consumer branch for sibling tool.
adjudication.reason: Remove unreachable branch; retain only accuracy and outcome_coverage as mandatory core.

adjudication.finding: Low: omitted confusion cells not explicitly zero.
adjudication.reason: Name the three omitted pairings as zero in both cohorts. Existing fixture-count tests verify complete nonzero cells and sums of 40.

adjudication.finding: Low: fixture alias protection may not support direct zip import.
adjudication.reason: Support checkout and normal pip-installed wheel files, both exercised. Direct execution inside a zip archive is not a supported distribution path; no demonstrated overwrite on supported paths.

adjudication.finding: Low: evidence precedence absent from generated schema descriptions.
adjudication.reason: EVIDENCE_POLICY already documents precedence; schema enums define possible values. Keep generated MCP/JSON schema equality rather than hand-editing a generated copy.
